title: TokenCake: A KV-Cache-centric Serving Framework for LLM-based Multi-Agent Applications
authors: Zhuohang Bian; Feiyang Wu; Zhuoran Li; Teng Ma; Youwei Zhuo
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache offloading, GPU memory tiering, Multi-tenant scheduling

problem_statement.en: Multi-agent LLM applications with frequent, long-running external function calls create two KV cache problems that existing serving systems handle poorly: temporal underutilization, where stalled agents' KV caches sit idle in GPU memory (up to 18.5% of KV cache blocks at peak), and spatial contention, where non-critical agents evict critical-path agents' caches (critical inversion), forcing costly recomputation that stalls the whole workflow.
problem_statement.zh: 依賴頻繁且長時間外部 function call 的多 agent LLM 應用，帶來現有服務系統難以處理的兩個 KV cache 問題：temporal underutilization——停滯 agent 的 KV cache 閒置於 GPU 記憶體（尖峰時最高佔 18.5% 的 KV cache blocks）；以及 spatial contention——非關鍵 agent 逐出關鍵路徑 agent 的 cache（critical inversion），迫使昂貴的重計算並使整個 workflow 停滯。

key_innovation.en: An agent-aware co-design of scheduling and memory management: a frontend API describing the application as a DAG with function-call stages; a Temporal Scheduler that opportunistically offloads idle KV caches to CPU memory on function-call events and predictively uploads them before agents resume (EWMA forecasting of tool duration); and a Spatial Scheduler that dynamically partitions GPU memory into shared and reserved pools via a hybrid priority metric combining graph structure and runtime state. Both schedulers coordinate through a shared pressure snapshot.
key_innovation.zh: agent 感知的排程與記憶體管理協同設計：frontend API 以帶 function call 階段的 DAG 描述應用；Temporal Scheduler 以 function call 事件驅動、機會式地將閒置 KV cache offload 至 CPU 記憶體，並藉由 EWMA 預測工具執行時間、在 agent 恢復前預測式 upload 回 GPU；Spatial Scheduler 依結合圖結構與執行期狀態的混合優先度指標，動態將 GPU 記憶體劃分為共享池與保留池。兩個 scheduler 透過共享的 pressure snapshot 協調。

key_improvements.en: Reduces end-to-end latency by over 47.06% vs vLLM under high load and improves effective GPU memory utilization by up to 16.9% (85.8–87.0% vs 69.9–74.1% for vLLM); 28.0% latency reduction over Mooncake at 0.5 QPS; measured KV cache recomputation is 26.8–37.5x slower than round-trip CPU migration.
key_improvements.zh: 高負載下相較 vLLM 端到端延遲降低超過 47.06%、有效 GPU 記憶體利用率最高提升 16.9%（85.8–87.0% vs vLLM 的 69.9–74.1%）；0.5 QPS 時相較 Mooncake 延遲降低 28.0%；量測顯示 KV cache 重計算比 CPU 往返遷移慢 26.8–37.5x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-agent Systems, AI Inference KV Cache transfer
offload_trigger: Function-call start event (call_start): when an agent emits a function call, the Temporal Scheduler proactively offloads the stalled agent's KV cache subject to a cost-benefit gate — not memory pressure or session inactivity.
prefetch_signal_timing: Predictive upload against the forecast function-call completion time (per-function-type EWMA blending user estimate with observed history); gradual budgeted upload as the deadline approaches, ranked by importance + urgency, with immediate upload on early call_finish.
costs_modeled: PCIe bandwidth, host DRAM capacity, GPU FLOPs recompute, transfer-vs-recompute crossover
agent_awareness: Exploits function-call (tool-call) idle gaps and the application's workflow DAG supplied via the frontend API: graph structure (depth, degree, critical path), function-call stages, and time estimates drive offload/upload timing and critical-path memory reservation.

when_to_offload_rule.en: Offload a stalled agent's KV cache at function-call start only when the predicted stall is long enough to cover the round-trip GPU-CPU transfer, a waiting request can use the freed GPU blocks, and the later upload can be prepared without displacing critical-path work.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 僅當三項條件同時成立時，才於 function call 開始時卸載停滯 agent 的 KV cache：預測的停滯時間足以涵蓋 GPU 與 CPU 之間的往返傳輸、存在可利用所釋放 GPU blocks 的等待請求、且後續 upload 可在不排擠 critical-path 工作的前提下完成。
